questions.question: Your 56s board PR-review edit has no audio or text. Which format should the social cut be?

options.label: 16:9 1080p (Recommended)
options.description: LinkedIn and X in-feed. Keeps your zooms intact, with no cropping of the board.

options.label: 16:9 + 4:5 portrait
options.description: Also a 1080x1350 version, framed with the brand background above and below the video, for mobile feeds.

options.label: 9:16 story/reel
options.description: 1080x1920 with the video centered and big captions. The board text will be small.

questions.question: What text should go on the video?

options.label: Hook + beat captions (Recommended)
options.description: An opening title card, short lower-third captions at key beats (prompt, board appears, review questions, eval chart), and an end card with glimmervoid.dev.

options.label: Title + end card only
options.description: Your edit plays untouched between a branded open and close.

options.label: No text, just encode
options.description: Re-encode for social size and bitrate limits only.
